content.short: COCOON is a decentralized AI compute network on TON designed for private and efficient AI processing.
content.description: The Confidential Compute Open Network (COCOON) is a pioneering decentralized infrastructure project designed to provide high-performance AI computing power for the TON and Telegram ecosystems. It allows users with powerful hardware to 'mine' by contributing their GPU resources to a global network, which processes AI models in a secure and private manner. By using confidential computing technology, COCOON ensures that sensitive data remains encrypted even during processing, offering a low-cost and decentralized alternative to centralized cloud providers for the next generation of AI dApps.
